feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: International news, global reporting and analysis from NPR. Plus dispatches from NPR’s State of the World podcast.

entry.title: Killer robots: U.N. talks fall short of hopes for legally binding rules
entry.summary: U.N. talks in Geneva have failed to deliver binding rules on autonomous weapons, as humanitarian groups warn that military AI is advancing far faster than diplomacy.

entry.title: Military analyst Phillips O'Brien on Ukraine and Europe being left out of Trump's talks
entry.summary: As President Trump met with Russian and Chinese counterparts, Ukraine and its European allies were left out of the talks. NPR's Scott Simon talks with Phillips O'Brien of St. Andrew's University.

entry.title: Anthropic worker claims to have solved a Holy Grail of math problems with the help of AI
entry.summary: A mathematician who works for artificial intelligence giant Anthropic claims he has solved a Holy Grail of math problems with the help of the company's AI tool Claude. It marks the second time in recent months that an AI company or someone linked to one claims to have cracked a famed unsolved math problem.

entry.title: Nations at UN talks on AI killer robots agree to more talks but no firm commitment to rein them in
entry.summary: Efforts to establish rules for AI-powered killer robots and drones have run aground. U.N.-backed talks in Geneva ended Saturday with an agreement to extend discussions for two more years.

entry.title: Another day of survival for a family in Ukraine
entry.summary: On the outskirts of Kyiv, one family prepares for the fifth winter of war against Russia -- stockpiling food and fuel and trying to maintain as much a sense of normalcy as possible.

entry.title: Trump touts meeting with Xi and Putin but offers few results
entry.summary: At a White House press conference Friday, Trump offered little in actual results of the meetings, beyond a joint statement on unity over some issues.

entry.title: Dems aim to block Iran war funding. And, Army delays lead azide detonation in Iowa
entry.summary: Congress needs to pass a funding measure to avoid a shutdown next month, providing Dems an opportunity to leverage power. And, the Army says waiting to detonate lead azide could become dangerous.

entry.title: GOP Sen. Johnson rejects tying government funding to an end to the Iran war
entry.summary: "We're not going to shut down the war," Sen. Ron Johnson said as Republicans and Democrats struggle to reach a government funding deal.

entry.title: The U.K. and EU hold a rare summit to strengthen ties
entry.summary: A decade after the people of Britain voted to leave the European Union, top EU officials are meeting with Prime Minister Andy Burnham on Friday, looking to mend more fences.

entry.title: The U.N.'s top court rules Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya
entry.summary: The International Court of Justice found that Myanmar security forces "acted with genocidal intent" against the Rohingya during military operations in the northern Rakhine state in 2017.
